# Peptides-UK.org — Full Technical & Academic Compendium
Version: 2026.1-UK
Jurisdiction: United Kingdom
Regulatory Standard: UK Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (In Vitro Laboratory Research Only)

---

## 1. Executive Directory Overview
Peptides-UK.org provides an independent, peer-reviewed academic registry of synthetic research peptides. It provides biochemical formulas, systematic IUPAC nomenclature, sequence data, preclinical signaling mechanisms, reconstitution standard operating procedures (SOPs), and supplier batch purity verifications.

---

## 2. Research Categories & Signaling Pathways

### Tissue Repair & Angiogenesis (`tissue-repair-recovery`)
- **Headline**: UK Laboratory Investigation into Cellular Migration & Microvascular Integrity
- **Description**: Rigorous biochemical analysis of synthetic peptide fragments investigated in focal adhesion kinase (FAK) phosphorylation, vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2 (VEGFR2) upregulation, and extracellular matrix fibrillogenesis across British in vitro models.
- **Signaling Focus**: FAK-Paxillin cascade phosphorylation, VEGFR2 transcription, eNOS modulation, actin cytoskeletal remodeling.
- **Featured Compounds**: bpc-157, tb-500
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/tissue-repair-recovery/

### Neuropeptides & CNS Signaling (`neuropeptides-cognition`)
- **Headline**: Pre-Clinical Neurotrophic Expression & Central Synaptic Modulation
- **Description**: Reference monographs documenting synthetic heptapeptides and regulatory fragments evaluated for neuroprotective signaling, brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) transcription, and monoaminergic receptor interactions in neurological assay systems.
- **Signaling Focus**: BDNF/TrkB axis upregulation, monoamine neurotransmitter turnover, endogenous enkephalinase inhibition, neurovascular preservation.
- **Featured Compounds**: semax, selank
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/neuropeptides-cognition/

### Growth Hormone Secretagogues & GHRH (`growth-hormone-secretagogues`)
- **Headline**: Anterior Pituitary Somatotroph Receptors & Pulsatile Endocrine Cascades
- **Description**: Analytical biochemical profiles for synthetic growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR-1a) agonists and growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) analogues evaluated for selective pituitary signaling and downstream IGF-1 transcription.
- **Signaling Focus**: GHSR-1a selective receptor binding, GHRH receptor signal transduction, pulsatile somatotroph release, minimal endocrine off-target elevation.
- **Featured Compounds**: cjc-1295, ipamorelin
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/growth-hormone-secretagogues/

### Metabolic & Incretin Signaling (`metabolic-regulation`)
- **Headline**: Dual Incretin Receptor Co-Agonism & Lipolytic Energy Dynamics
- **Description**: Biochemical reference dossiers for synthetic unimolecular co-agonists and lipolytic peptide sequences investigated in GLP-1, GIP, and beta-3 adrenergic receptor pathways controlling cellular energy homeostasis.
- **Signaling Focus**: GLP-1R / GIPR co-agonism, cellular cAMP cascades, hormone-sensitive lipase (HSL) activation, mitochondrial lipid oxidation.
- **Featured Compounds**: aod-9604, tirzepatide, semaglutide
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/metabolic-regulation/

### Dermal & Extracellular Matrix (`dermal-extracellular-matrix`)
- **Headline**: Copper Chelation Dynamics & Fibroblast Procollagen Remodeling
- **Description**: Analytical laboratory profiles of copper-binding tripeptides studied for coordinate complex formation, matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) homeostasis, decorin synthesis, and dermal fibroblast motility.
- **Signaling Focus**: Copper (Cu2+) coordination geometry, TGF-beta signaling modulation, procollagen Type I and III transcription, MMP regulation.
- **Featured Compounds**: ghk-cu
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/dermal-extracellular-matrix/

### Cellular Longevity & Mitochondrial Axis (`cellular-longevity-mitochondrial`)
- **Headline**: Telomeric Chromatin Architecture & Mitochondrial-Derived Bioenergetics
- **Description**: Investigative profiles of synthetic tetrapeptides and mitochondrial open reading frame-derived peptides analyzed for telomerase catalytic subunit (hTERT) activation, cardiolipin preservation, and cellular ROS mitigation.
- **Signaling Focus**: TERT gene promoter activation, AMPK phosphorylation, complex I/IV electron chain stabilization, cellular stress resistance.
- **Featured Compounds**: epithalon, mots-c
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/category/cellular-longevity-mitochondrial/

## 3. Comprehensive Compound Monographs

### BPC-157 — Body Protection Compound-157 Pentadecapeptide
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/bpc-157/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 137525-51-0
- **Molecular Formula**: C62H98N16O22
- **Molecular Weight**: 1419.55 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 9941957
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Gly - Glu - Pro - Pro - Pro - Gly - Lys - Pro - Ala - Asp - Asp - Ala - Gly - Leu - Val
- **Research Category**: Tissue Repair & Angiogenesis (`tissue-repair-recovery`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
BPC-157 is a stable 15-amino acid synthetic pentadecapeptide fragment originally derived from human gastric juice protein BPC. Evaluated in UK academic and biotechnology laboratories as an analytical benchmark for focal adhesion kinase (FAK) activation and endothelial tube formation assays.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Induces transcriptional activation of VEGFR2 and mediates early angiogenic capillary sprouting in explanted endothelial microenvironments.
- Phosphorylates the FAK-Paxillin kinase cascade, accelerating in vitro tendon and ligament fibroblast migration across scratch assays.
- Modulates constitutive nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) transcription while attenuating inducible iNOS inflammatory expression.
- Downregulates pro-inflammatory cytokines including TNF-alpha, IL-6, and myeloperoxidase in isolated preclinical tissue models.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Extensively investigated across British and European pharmacological laboratories for gastrointestinal epithelial integrity, transected Achilles tendon remodeling, and neurovascular preservation. strictly formulated for in vitro academic and biotechnological assay models.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP or Sterile Reconstitution Diluent
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated in inert argon atmosphere (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from actinic light (stable 28 days)
- **Stability Window**: Aqueous peptide degrades rapidly above 25°C or across repeated freeze-thaw cycles
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 1419.55 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 250 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.2% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/bpc-157/)

- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: PEN | Purity: ≥99.4% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/bpc-157/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **Pentadecapeptide BPC 157 and its role in promoting tendon healing: Accelerated outgrowth and migration of tendon fibroblasts** (2011)
  *Journal of Applied Physiology* by Chang CH, Tsai WC, Hsu YH, Pang JH. PMID: 21030672. DOI: 10.1152/japplphysiol.00945.2010
  *Key Finding*: Demonstrated dose-dependent acceleration of tendon explant outgrowth and enhanced FAK phosphorylation in cultured tendon fibroblasts.
- **Stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 in the treatment of colitis and gastrointestinal lesions** (2014)
  *Current Pharmaceutical Design* by Sikiric P, Seiwerth S, Rucman R, et al.. PMID: 23795744. DOI: 10.2174/13816128113199990411
  *Key Finding*: Established mucosal preservation, eNOS upregulation, and reduction of ischemic oxidative damage in endothelial models.

### TB-500 — Thymosin Beta-4 Active Hexapeptide Domain (Ac-LKKTET-OH)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/tb-500/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 77591-33-4
- **Molecular Formula**: C212H350N56O78S
- **Molecular Weight**: 4963.50 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 16132341
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Ac-Leu - Lys - Lys - Thr - Glu - Thr-OH
- **Research Category**: Tissue Repair & Angiogenesis (`tissue-repair-recovery`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
TB-500 represents the synthetic active fragment of Thymosin Beta-4, a major physiological actin-sequestering protein. Studied in British biomedical research for its ability to regulate G-actin polymerization, promote keratinocyte migration, and downregulate myofibroblast differentiation.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Binds monomeric G-actin in 1:1 stoichiometry, preventing premature polymerization and facilitating rapid cellular motility.
- Stimulates matrix metalloproteinase production (MMP-2 and MMP-9) during controlled endothelial reorganization.
- Upregulates vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) transcription.
- Inhibits cellular apoptosis in cardiomyocytes and vascular endothelial cells subjected to oxidative hypoxia.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Frequently investigated alongside BPC-157 in dual-pathway tissue remodeling protocols. Subject to strict laboratory handling and reconstituted under laminar flow hoods for in vitro experimentation.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dry vacuum-sealed (stable 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated (stable 21 days)
- **Stability Window**: Highly sensitive to mechanical shear and agitation during dissolution
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 4963.5 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 500 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.0% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/tb500/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **Thymosin beta4 promotes dermal healing in pre-clinical wound models** (2003)
  *Wound Repair and Regeneration* by Malinda KM, Sidhu GS, Mani H, et al.. PMID: 12654014. DOI: 10.1046/j.1524-475x.2003.11116.x
  *Key Finding*: Observed significant acceleration in re-epithelialization and collagen deposition in dermal tissue explants.

### Semax — Heptapeptide ACTH(4-10) Analog (Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/semax/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 80714-61-0
- **Molecular Formula**: C37H51N9O10S
- **Molecular Weight**: 813.92 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 122178
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Met - Glu - His - Phe - Pro - Gly - Pro
- **Research Category**: Neuropeptides & CNS Signaling (`neuropeptides-cognition`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Semax is a synthetic regulatory heptapeptide structurally derived from an adrenocorticotropic hormone fragment (ACTH 4-10) stabilized with a C-terminal Pro-Gly-Pro tripeptide. Examined in neuropharmacology laboratories for its modulation of BDNF, trkB receptors, and cerebral monoamines.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Upregulates brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) and nerve growth factor (NGF) mRNA transcription in hippocampal neurons.
- Enhances tyrosine kinase receptor B (trkB) phosphorylation, facilitating synaptic plasticity and dendritic arborization.
- Modulates dopamine and serotonin metabolic turnover in prefrontal cortical tissue slices.
- Provides neuroprotective ischemic mitigation by suppressing inducible nitric oxide synthase and caspase-3 cascades.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Available as lyophilized powder or metered intranasal aqueous formulation. Demonstrates high enzymatic stability against carboxypeptidases owing to the C-terminal Pro-Gly-Pro motif.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Sterile Deionized Water USP or Saline Reagent Grade
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dark vacuum desiccator (stable 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from light (stable 30 days)
- **Stability Window**: Enzymatically stable peptide; avoid repeated freezing and thawing cycles
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 813.92 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 300 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: SPRAY | Purity: ≥99.1% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/semax/)

- **Direct Sarms**: Format: SPRAY | Purity: ≥98.6% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom Express | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://direct-sarms.com#semax/)
- **Peptide Works**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥98.9% (HPLC) | Dispatch: Manchester UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://peptide-works.com)
- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: SPRAY | Purity: ≥99.3% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/semax/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **Semax, an ACTH(4-10) analogue with nootropic properties, stimulates BDNF expression in the rat hippocampus** (2006)
  *Neuroscience Letters* by Dolotov OV, Eremin KO, Andreeva LA, et al.. PMID: 16950577. DOI: 10.1016/j.neulet.2006.07.070
  *Key Finding*: Reported rapid multi-fold induction of hippocampal BDNF mRNA and protein expression within 3 hours.

### GHK-Cu — Copper Tripeptide-1 Complex (Gly-His-Lys:Cu2+)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/ghk-cu/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 49557-75-7
- **Molecular Formula**: C14H24CuN6O4
- **Molecular Weight**: 403.92 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 73587
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Gly - His - Lys
- **Research Category**: Dermal & Extracellular Matrix (`dermal-extracellular-matrix`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
GHK-Cu is a naturally occurring tripeptide-copper coordinate complex identified in human plasma. Investigated in UK cosmetic chemistry and cellular biology laboratories for its regulation of matrix metalloproteinases, decorin, and collagen I/III biosynthesis.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Chelates Cu2+ ions in square-planar coordinate geometry, facilitating delivery to dermal cuproenzymes including lysyl oxidase.
- Stimulates gene expression of collagen alpha-1 type I and III in cultured dermal fibroblasts.
- Downregulates matrix metalloproteinase-1 (MMP-1) while upregulating tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases-1 (TIMP-1).
- Neutralizes reactive oxygen species and suppresses iron-mediated lipid peroxidation in cell membranes.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Easily recognized by its distinct intense royal blue appearance in aqueous solution due to copper complexation. Evaluated in both dermal regeneration assays and general wound healing models.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Sterile Bacteriostatic Water USP or Sterile Saline Reagent
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dark vacuum desiccator (stable up to 36 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from UV light (stable 45 days)
- **Stability Window**: Stable complex; do not mix with strong reducing agents or ascorbic acid
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 403.92 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 1000 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.3% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/ghk-cu/)

- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.5% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/ghk-cu/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **The human tripeptide GHK and tissue remodeling** (2008)
  *Journal of Biomaterials Science, Polymer Edition* by Pickart L. PMID: 18644225. DOI: 10.1163/156856208784909435
  *Key Finding*: Detailed broad gene remodeling across collagen synthesis, antioxidant enzymes, and anti-inflammatory pathways.

### CJC-1295 — Modified Growth Hormone-Releasing Hormone (Mod GRF 1-29 / CJC-1295 No DAC)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/cjc-1295/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 863288-34-0
- **Molecular Formula**: C152H252N44O42
- **Molecular Weight**: 3367.97 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 56841935
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Tyr - D-Ala - Asp - Ala - Ile - Phe - Thr - Gln - Ser - Tyr - Arg - Lys - Val - Leu - Ala - Gln - Leu - Ser - Ala - Arg - Lys - Leu - Leu - Gln - Asp - Ile - Leu - Ser - Arg-NH2
- **Research Category**: Growth Hormone Secretagogues & GHRH (`growth-hormone-secretagogues`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
CJC-1295 (Mod GRF 1-29) is a synthetic 29-amino-acid analogue of human growth hormone-releasing factor featuring four D-amino acid substitutions to enhance metabolic stability against dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4). Evaluated in UK endocrine research for pulsatile somatotroph signaling.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Selectively activates the pituitary GHRH receptor, initiating adenylate cyclase and cAMP signaling.
- Triggers physiological, pulsatile growth hormone secretion preserving negative feedback regulation.
- Stimulates hepatic IGF-1 synthesis and circulating IGFBP-3 transcription in pre-clinical models.
- D-Ala2 and D-Arg substitutions resist enzymatic degradation, extending in vitro biological half-life.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Typically studied in conjunction with GHSR-1a agonists like Ipamorelin to investigate synergistic pituitary secretion kinetics. Kept frozen in lyophilized form and protected from thermal extremes.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated in inert gas (stable 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from light (stable 21 days)
- **Stability Window**: Reconstituted solution degrades above 25°C; avoid repeated freezing
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 3367.97 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 100 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.2% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/cjc-1295-no-dac/)

- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: PEN | Purity: ≥99.4% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/cjc-1295-no-dac/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **Pulsatile growth hormone secretion after administration of CJC-1295** (2006)
  *Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism* by Teichman SL, Neale A, Lawrence B, et al.. PMID: 16352683. DOI: 10.1210/jc.2005-1536
  *Key Finding*: Observed significant sustained elevation in cumulative GH and IGF-1 secretion while preserving pulsatility.

### Ipamorelin — Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2 Pentapeptide
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/ipamorelin/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 170851-70-4
- **Molecular Formula**: C38H49N9O5
- **Molecular Weight**: 711.86 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 9831659
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Aib - His - D-2-Nal - D-Phe - Lys-NH2
- **Research Category**: Growth Hormone Secretagogues & GHRH (`growth-hormone-secretagogues`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Ipamorelin is a synthetic pentapeptide and selective ghrelin receptor (GHSR-1a) agonist. Distinct from earlier GHRPs due to its selectivity: it stimulates somatotroph growth hormone release in vitro without triggering substantial elevation in cortisol, prolactin, or ACTH.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Selectively activates pituitary and hypothalamic GHSR-1a receptors via G-protein coupled phospholipase C.
- Elevates intracellular inositol trisphosphate (IP3) and calcium mobilization in somatotroph cells.
- Displays minimal binding affinity for corticotropin or prolactin receptors, ensuring endocrine selectivity.
- Demonstrates high synergy with GHRH analogues across pre-clinical endocrine assays.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Considered one of the cleanest research tools for investigating somatotrophic secretory pulses and lipid metabolism without the confounding endocrine perturbations seen with GHRP-6 or GHRP-2.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from light (stable 28 days)
- **Stability Window**: Enzymatically stable pentapeptide; keep tightly sealed in glass vials
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 711.86 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 100 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.3% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/ipamorelin/)
- **Direct Peptides**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.1% (HPLC) | Dispatch: UK Hub & Europe | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://direct-peptides.com#ipamorelin/)
- **Direct Sarms**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥98.8% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom Express | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://direct-sarms.com#ipamorelin/)
- **Peptide Works**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.0% (HPLC) | Dispatch: Manchester UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://peptide-works.com)
- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: PEN | Purity: ≥99.5% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/ipamorelin/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **Ipamorelin, the first selective growth hormone secretagogue** (1998)
  *European Journal of Endocrinology* by Raun K, Hansen BS, Johansen PB, et al.. PMID: 9849822. DOI: 10.1530/eje.0.1390552
  *Key Finding*: Characterized complete selectivity for GH release with zero effect on ACTH, cortisol, or prolactin levels.

### AOD-9604 — Human Growth Hormone C-Terminal Fragment (Tyr-hGH177-191)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/aod-9604/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 221231-10-3
- **Molecular Formula**: C78H123N23O23S2
- **Molecular Weight**: 1815.12 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 16132339
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Tyr - Leu - Arg - Ile - Val - Gln - Cys - Arg - Ser - Val - Glu - Gly - Ser - Cys - Gly - Phe
- **Research Category**: Metabolic & Incretin Signaling (`metabolic-regulation`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
AOD-9604 is a synthetic hexadecapeptide analog representing the lipolytic C-terminal domain of human growth hormone (hGH 177-191) with an added tyrosine residue. Investigated in UK metabolic and adipose tissue laboratories for beta-3 adrenergic receptor signaling without diabetogenic IGF-1 elevation.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Selectively activates lipolysis via beta-3 adrenergic receptor pathways in isolated adipocyte assays.
- Stimulates hormone-sensitive lipase (HSL) phosphorylation, accelerating triacylglycerol breakdown.
- Inhibits lipogenesis by suppressing acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity in adipose tissue explants.
- Does not bind the human growth hormone receptor, avoiding insulin antagonism and mitogenic stimulation.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Contains an internal disulfide bond between Cys7 and Cys14 required for biological conformation. Careful handling is necessary to avoid reduction of this disulfide bridge during reconstitution.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dry vacuum desiccator (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated (stable 21 days)
- **Stability Window**: Disulfide bridge sensitive to reducing agents (DTT, beta-mercaptoethanol)
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 1815.12 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 300 mcg

#### Verified Supplier Sources
- **PharmaGrade Store**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.1% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom (Royal Mail 24) | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmagrade.store/product-category/aod-9604/)
- **Direct Peptides**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.0% (HPLC) | Dispatch: UK Hub & Europe | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://direct-peptides.com#aod-9604/)
- **Direct Sarms**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥98.5% (HPLC) | Dispatch: United Kingdom Express | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://direct-sarms.com#peptides/)
- **Peptide Works**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥98.7% (HPLC) | Dispatch: Manchester UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://peptide-works.com)
- **PharmaLab Global**: Format: VIAL | Purity: ≥99.3% (HPLC) | Dispatch: London UK Hub | [Supplier Catalog Link](https://pharmalabglobal.com/product-category/aod-9604/)

#### Peer-Reviewed Academic Citations
- **The effect of AOD9604, a novel growth hormone fragment, on lipolysis and metabolic parameters in pre-clinical models** (2004)
  *Obesity Research* by Ng FM, Sun J, Sharma L, et al.. PMID: 15044670. DOI: 10.1038/oby.2004.87
  *Key Finding*: Demonstrated significant lipolytic activity without alteration in serum glucose or insulin sensitivity markers.

### Selank — Synthetic Tuftsin Heptapeptide Analogue (Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/selank/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 129954-34-3
- **Molecular Formula**: C33H57N11O9
- **Molecular Weight**: 751.88 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 11765600
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Thr - Lys - Pro - Arg - Pro - Gly - Pro
- **Research Category**: Neuropeptides & CNS Signaling (`neuropeptides-cognition`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Selank is a synthetic regulatory heptapeptide derived from the immunomodulatory tetrapeptide tuftsin, extended with a C-terminal Pro-Gly-Pro tripeptide. Examined in neuroimmunology laboratories for its allosteric modulation of GABAA receptors, enkephalinase inhibition, and IL-6 expression.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Acts as a positive allosteric modulator at GABAA receptor complexes, enhancing inhibitory neurotransmission.
- Inhibits enkephalin-degrading enzymes in blood plasma and neural tissue, elevating endogenous opioid signaling.
- Regulates expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and TNF-alpha in mononuclear blood cells.
- Modulates brain serotonin and dopamine turnover rates without benzodiazepine-like sedation or tolerance.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Stabilized against circulating peptidases by the Pro-Gly-Pro sequence. Frequently cataloged in neurotrophic assays alongside Semax to evaluate comparative cognitive and anxiolytic receptor pathways.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Sterile Deionized Water USP or Bacteriostatic Water
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dark vacuum desiccator (stable 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from light (stable 30 days)
- **Stability Window**: Enzymatically stable heptapeptide; keep shielded from UV radiation
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 751.88 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 250 mcg

### Epithalon — Synthetic Pineal Tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/epithalon/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 307297-39-8
- **Molecular Formula**: C14H22N4O9
- **Molecular Weight**: 390.35 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 219035
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Ala - Glu - Asp - Gly
- **Research Category**: Cellular Longevity & Mitochondrial Axis (`cellular-longevity-mitochondrial`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Epithalon (Epitalon) is a synthetic tetrapeptide modeled on the endogenous pineal extract epithalamin. Studied extensively in biogerontology laboratories for its ability to overcome the Hayflick limit via telomerase catalytic subunit (hTERT) transcription and chromatin remodeling.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Triggers transcriptional activation of the human telomerase reverse transcriptase (hTERT) promoter.
- Elongates telomeres in cultured human somatic cells, extending cellular replicative lifespan in vitro.
- Downregulates pro-oxidant pathways while stimulating superoxide dismutase and glutathione peroxidase.
- Normalizes melatonin circadian rhythmicity and neuroendocrine signaling in pineal explants.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Remarkably small molecular weight (390.35 g/mol) facilitating rapid diffusion in cellular cultures. Evaluated across aging models and chromosomal stability assays.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Sterile Bacteriostatic Water USP or Sterile Saline
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C dark vacuum desiccator (stable up to 36 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; protect from actinic light (stable 35 days)
- **Stability Window**: Highly stable tetrapeptide; resistant to standard enzymatic hydrolysis
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 390.35 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 1000 mcg

### MOTS-c — Mitochondrial Open Reading Frame of the 12S rRNA-c (16-AA Peptide)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/mots-c/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 1627580-64-6
- **Molecular Formula**: C101H152N28O22S2
- **Molecular Weight**: 2174.62 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 138896561
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Met - Arg - Trp - Gln - Glu - Met - Gly - Tyr - Ile - Phe - Tyr - Pro - Arg - Lys - Leu - Arg
- **Research Category**: Cellular Longevity & Mitochondrial Axis (`cellular-longevity-mitochondrial`)
- **Evidence Level**: mixed (2/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
MOTS-c is a 16-amino acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 12S rRNA locus. Investigated in metabolic biology laboratories for its regulation of the folate-methionine cycle, direct activation of AMPK, and restoration of metabolic plasticity.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Translocates to the nucleus under metabolic stress to regulate nuclear gene expression via antioxidant response elements (ARE).
- Directly activates adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) through inhibition of the folate cycle.
- Enhances cellular glucose uptake in myotubes via GLUT4 translocation independent of classical insulin signaling.
- Prevents high-fat diet-induced insulin resistance and mitigates cellular oxidative stress in mitochondrial assays.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Hydrophobic and thermally sensitive peptide requiring precise cold-chain handling during reconstitution to avoid aggregation and precipitation.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; use within 14 days
- **Stability Window**: Hydrophobic sequence prone to fibrillation; do not vortex or shake vigorously
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 2174.62 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 5000 mcg

### Tirzepatide — Dual GIP and GLP-1 Receptor Co-Agonist 39-AA Synthetic Peptide
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/tirzepatide/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 2023788-19-2
- **Molecular Formula**: C225H348N48O68
- **Molecular Weight**: 4813.45 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 156588324
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: Tyr - Aib - Glu - Gly - Thr - Phe - Thr - Ser - Asp - Tyr - Ser - Ile - Aib - Leu - Asp - Lys - Ile - Ala - Gln - Lys(AEEAc-AEEAc-gamma-Glu-1,20-eicosanedioic acid) - Ala - Phe - Val - Gln - Trp - Leu - Ile - Ala - Gly - Gly - Pro - Ser - Ser - Gly - Ala - Pro - Pro - Pro - Ser-NH2
- **Research Category**: Metabolic & Incretin Signaling (`metabolic-regulation`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Tirzepatide is a synthetic 39-amino-acid unimolecular dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor co-agonist conjugated to a C20 fatty diacid moiety. Studied extensively in UK biochemical and pharmaceutical research for receptor affinity dynamics.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Co-activates both GIP and GLP-1 receptors, delivering potent synergistic cyclic AMP second messenger signaling.
- Possesses high affinity for the GIP receptor equal to native GIP, with balanced lower affinity for GLP-1R.
- Stimulates glucose-dependent insulin secretion from pancreatic beta cells while suppressing inappropriate glucagon.
- C20 fatty diacid acylation binds human serum albumin non-covalently, extending pharmacokinetic half-life to ~5 days.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
High molecular weight (4813.45 g/mol) requiring gentle reconstitution. Used as a gold-standard dual incretin benchmark in comparative pharmacology assays.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; do not freeze (stable 28 days)
- **Stability Window**: High molecular weight peptide; avoid vigorous agitation during dissolution
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 4813.45 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 2500 mcg

### Semaglutide — Acylated GLP-1 Analogue (31-AA Chain with C18 Diacid Spacer)
- **Canonical URL**: https://peptides-uk.org/peptides/semaglutide/
- **CAS Registry Number**: 910463-68-2
- **Molecular Formula**: C187H291N45O59
- **Molecular Weight**: 4113.58 g/mol
- **PubChem CID**: 56843331
- **Amino Acid Sequence**: His - Aib - Glu - Gly - Thr - Phe - Thr - Ser - Asp - Val - Ser - Ser - Tyr - Leu - Glu - Gly - Gln - Ala - Ala - Lys(AEEAc-AEEAc-gamma-Glu-17-carboxyheptadecanoyl) - Glu - Phe - Ile - Ala - Trp - Leu - Val - Arg - Gly - Arg - Gly
- **Research Category**: Metabolic & Incretin Signaling (`metabolic-regulation`)
- **Evidence Level**: human (3/3 stars)

#### Preclinical Overview
Semaglutide is a synthetic long-acting glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist modified at position 8 with alpha-aminoisobutyric acid (Aib) and acylated at Lys26 with a C18 fatty diacid chain. Studied in UK endocrinology and metabolic research as a classical mono-incretin reference standard.

#### Biochemical Mechanisms of Action
- Potently and selectively activates the human GLP-1 receptor, initiating cellular adenylate cyclase activation.
- Aib substitution at position 8 confers total resistance against proteolytic degradation by dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4).
- C18 fatty diacid spacer facilitates strong reversible binding to serum albumin, prolonging biological half-life to ~165 hours.
- Suppresses postprandial glucagon secretion and delays gastric motility in isolated physiological models.

#### Laboratory Handling & Research Notes
Benchmark peptide for incretin-based scientific investigations. Handled with sterile laboratory precautions and maintained refrigerated after reconstitution.

#### Reconstitution & Stability Protocols
- **Recommended Diluent**: Bacteriostatic 0.9% Benzyl Alcohol USP
- **Lyophilized Storage**: -20°C desiccated (stable up to 24 months)
- **Reconstituted Solution Storage**: 2°C to 8°C refrigerated; do not freeze (stable 30 days)
- **Stability Window**: Store away from light; avoid mechanical frothing during dissolution
- **Molecular Weight Baseline**: 4113.58 g/mol
- **Standard Experimental Baseline**: 1000 mcg

  *Key Finding*: Documented substantial reductions in cardiovascular death, nonfatal stroke, and myocardial infarction in trial models.

## 5. UK Regulatory & Legal Framework
In the United Kingdom, synthetic peptides supplied for research purposes are governed by the **Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (SI 2012/1916)** and the **Misuse of Drugs Act 1971**. 

Compounds distributed without Marketing Authorisation (MA) are strictly prohibited from being advertised or sold with medicinal claims, human dosing instructions, or therapeutic efficacy representations. They are legally restricted to bona fide laboratory, academic, and industrial research in vitro.
